definitions.gloss: time passes; time goes by; time elapses
definitions.explanation: A common expression meaning that time moves forward or a period of time has elapsed. Used to describe the passage of time in both concrete and emotional contexts.

examples.japanese: {時間|じかん}が{経|た}つ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧。
⟦あれ→あれ：00916_are⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧{時間|じかん}が{経|た}った。
examples.english: Three years have passed since then.

examples.japanese: {時間|じかん}が{経|た}つ⟦につれて→につれて：28400_nitsurete⟧、⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{癒|い}えて→癒える：20856_ieru⟧いった。
examples.english: As time went by, the wound gradually healed.

notes:
One of the most frequently used time expressions in Japanese. The verb ⟦{経|た}つ→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧ ('to elapse; to pass') is specific to the passage of time and is distinct from the homophone ⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ ('to stand').

USAGE:
- Often used with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧ to express surprise at how quickly time passes.
- The pattern {時間|じかん}が{経|た}つ⟦につれて→につれて：28400_nitsurete⟧ ('as time passes') is very common for describing gradual change.
- Can be modified with specific time periods: ⟦{一時間|いちじかん}→一時間：00941_ichijikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}つ→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧ ('one hour passes'), ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{時間|じかん}が{経|た}つ ('a long time passes').
- In casual speech, {時間|じかん}が{経|た}つ is sometimes shortened to {時|とき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}つ→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧ or ⟦{月日|つきひ}→月日：04063_tsukihi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}つ→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {時間|じかん}が{経|た}つ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧: time passes quickly
- {時間|じかん}が{経|た}つ⟦につれて→につれて：28400_nitsurete⟧: as time goes by
- だいぶ{時間|じかん}が{経|た}った: quite some time has passed
- {時間|じかん}が{経|た}って⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: even after time passes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{月日|つきひ}→月日：04063_tsukihi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}つ→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧: days and months pass — a more literary or reflective variant emphasizing the slow accumulation of time
- {時|とき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧: time flows — a more poetic expression
- ⟦{年月|ねんげつ}→年月：00310_nengetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: years pass — emphasizes the passage of longer periods
